pages.search_intent: compare an exact dry-herb vaporizer capsule system by documented fit, adapter, care status, clean return testing, recurring burden, and complete ownership cost

monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured. The conversion improvement materially expands an existing purchase-intent dosing-capsule guide with a three-system worksheet, complete recurring-burden formulas, a clean seven-step return-window test, explicit rejection gates, and a direct path to the site's product-neutral ownership-cost worksheet. No merchant, model recommendation, live price, stock, rating, discount, testing claim, or affiliate link was added.

image_qa.note: Both materially changed resources intentionally use text, tables, checklists, and existing interface assets. No QR code, cannabis package, certificate, device, capsule, merchant, affiliate, stock, product, or generated image was added or changed, avoiding a fake scannable destination or exact-model mismatch.

search_console.decision: The October 12–November 8 report is four days old and valid: 815 impressions, three clicks, 0.368% CTR, and average position 24.093. Arkansas was the only page-level signal with more than a token sample in positions 4–20 and was materially reinforced on November 12. The two-impression 510-versus-disposable row already maps to a complete page; Delaware had two impressions, Blue Dream averaged about position 48, and the remaining rows were one-impression noise. No item is labeled Data-led; those weak or already-served signals were deliberately ignored. The sitemap-submission error favored stronger static hub and reciprocal discovery paths but does not justify inventing a new canonical endpoint or claiming Search Console property access.

authority.action: Published a citation-worthy QR destination and exact-lot verification asset grounded in current FTC, CISA, and New York OCM guidance. Its job map, destination record, character-by-character package/report match, suspicious-request screen, recovery lanes, accessible alternative, and bounded New York example strengthen the label, CoA, laboratory-limit, licensed-seller, fraud, and product-complaint cluster. One qualified New York OCM consumer-education opportunity was logged; no outreach was sent.
